title: Wake up
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) I awoke in a house I didnt know. The people that I could recognize. I couldntt put names to each one since this dream is a blurr. I was trapped in this house. They lock it at night to keep 'bad men' out. A crazy guy lived next door that hated women. As I was laying in a bed next to the girl that was close to my age. We both wanted to kiss eachother. So we did, it escalated to us grinding on eachother but than I heard someone at the door. So I pulled the covers over us and pretended I was asleep. The mom came in drug her daughter, said shes locking the door so that guy doesnt come back in and cause havoc. I got an immediate uneasy feeling and snuck my way to the front door. I realized I've escaped this house before in a different dream wtf. So I put on random shoes as fast as I could and just started running. One of the bigger ladies decided she was gunna chase after me. But I'm really fast and catch on so I figured after running straight I'd turn left than left again. I was on a completely different street. I traveled downtown trying to escape and than I saw a child almost dropping a little black cat. So I took it from her and continued on my way finding home. Well long story short I found my way home. Which I never go to in my dreamworld because bad things always happen when I'm there. So I toughened up and went inside. I immediately woke up in my bed but I felt weird. I couldnt cry even though I was upset, my body felt numb and distant. I walked into the bathroom and turned on the light. Everything was normal. I was awake or so I thought. I looked in the mirror and my eyes looked really tired. Like I smoked a big joint. When i didnt. My moms coffee mug was in the bathroom like she was sup for work getting ready. So I assumed I woke up really early. I told her I had a bad dream and my body now feels weird. I said the same thing to my stepdad as I gave each my parents a hug. As I hugged my stepdad than stood there after I realized my body doesnt feel real. I than woke up for real in my bed. I'm writing this now so confused. I hate trying to escape the down town portion of mall world. Does anyone want me to make a map of my version of mall world?
